scope: Radar only. Local historical development, no live issuance or promotion.
problem: Original retrospective evaluation required all first24 telemetry features finite, whereas current inference only requires finite Muçum base level. Evaluate both controls and candidates on every scheduled historical origin/target, preserving unavailable base levels and targets.
features: Original120 telemetry predictors plus60 previous_day1 weather accumulations, identical order and source snapshot from mucum-atualizacao-15h-2026-09-21. No HGE component, reservoir augmentation, new observations, imputation or clipping.
baseline: Original HistGradientBoostingRegressor family arvores_previsao_chuva, same training requirement of finite H,target and first24 telemetry predictors. Verify original saved test predictions for overlapping rows before claiming reproduction.
candidate: Same HistGradientBoostingRegressor and180 features; training requires finite H and target only. Native missing branches handle missing auxiliary predictors. Inference also requires only H, for both baseline and candidate.
parameters: Per-horizon parameters frozen from BASE/previsao-atualizada.csv. max_iter180,min_samples_leaf35,learning_rate0.055,l2_regularization10,early_stoppingFalse,random_state57. Unchanged sample weights1+2*(abs(delta)>=1)+2*(target>=9), delta=target-H. No new search.
validation: Training labels before2025-10-01; evaluate origins fromOct1 with targets beforeJuly1/2026. Parameters had already been selected on this validation period: descriptive development, not independent validation.
test: Use union of original preOct training and Oct-to-July validation origins, each with target strictly before its original cutoff, matching historical baseline membership. This deliberately preserves the small Oct boundary exclusion of the original audit; operational runner uses a single later cutoff and is not silently changed. Test all origins July1 through targets beforeSeptember21.
evaluation: Every scheduled row, both families, all nominal horizons1..12, all targets and observed>=7m. Separately label original complete24-input sample and missing24-input sample. Count missing targets, base levels, pairs, failures and coverage. Report hits<=0.50m,MAE,bias,P98,max per horizon. Missing auxiliary data must not select a favorable evaluation sample.
limits: Fixed source-delay assumptions, revised history and previous_day1 archived forecasts do not prove source availability at historical issue times. All periods were already inspected. Keep original observations and every failure; no 98percent or prospective claim.
